proof.inputs: RCX reader is saved in RDI; RDX MethodInfo is saved in RBX. Initialize its RGCTX at +0x38, take RGCTX[0] as the formatter-provider MethodInfo, and initialize a null result local.
proof.inlinedProvider: The clone inlines the complete provider at 0x185003f90: both load provider RGCTX[0], obtain its runtime type key, use the identical cache and monitor cells, hash/probe/insert with the same callees, including chained fallback fragments, and obtain the same R14 cache entry. Both pass R14 through 0x185004510, resolve the identical expected formatter type from provider RGCTX, and use the same type check and exception path. RBP holds the provider MethodInfo in both. Clone stack locals differ by +0x18 and it reloads the saved reader after the cache loop.
proof.registeredBody: The registered ReadValue<System.Object> body independently initializes a null local, loads MethodInfo.RGCTX[0], calls that same provider, and invokes virtual slot 5 with formatter, reader and address of result. The clone performs exactly this invocation after the inlined provider and returns its result local.
proof.dispatch: Both pass ECX=5, RDX=formatter, R8=reader, R9=&null-initialized result to the same dispatch helper. Its generic path preserves all operands and invokes the slot with its MethodInfo; selected optimized branches are shared by both callers.
proof.boundary: This proves the reference-sharing generic read, not a special Param formatter layout.
